_comment: Usage meter settings. Applied by deploy.sh as ConfigMap zai-meter-config;
the meter re-reads it on every request, so no restart is needed (the
kubelet takes up to a minute to refresh a mounted ConfigMap).
rates: price per hour, by resource. Each card applies from its `from` month
until a later card starts, so raising prices never rewrites past months.
0 or missing = not charged (the statement still shows the hours).
gpu:mig-1g.35gb  one GPU Standard slice held for an hour
gpu:mig-2g.35gb  one GPU Large slice held for an hour
cpu              one CPU core (the server's limit) for an hour
mem_gb           one GB of memory (the server's limit) for an hour
default_gpu_budget_hours: GPU slice-hours per user per month, or null for
no limit. Admins can override it per user, or change it for everyone, on
/hub/usage; those settings take precedence over this value.
idle_busy_threshold: a GPU minute below this compute activity (0..1)
counts as idle in the admin report.
